title: Hallmark fix report
description: What the fixer did. Hallmark checks it against the worktree: the IDs must be open findings, and fixes need a new commit.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what you changed and why.

fixed.description: IDs of the findings your commits fix, such as F1. Empty when only failing checks were fixed.

disputed.description: Findings you dispute instead of fixing, each with a concrete reason.
